title.en: Check whether the goal is reachable

concept.zh: 在格子地图中使用 DFS

brief.zh: 实现 depth_first_reachable(board, start, goal)，判断芽芽能否只沿上下左右走到目标。坐标用 [x, y]。圆点可走，井号是墙。
brief.en: Implement depth_first_reachable(board, start, goal). Return whether Sprout can reach the goal by stepping up, right, down, or left. Coordinates use [x, y]. Dots are floor and # marks a wall.

hints.zh: 栈里放位置。每次取出一个位置，检查四个相邻格，并把还没记录的地板格放进栈。
hints.en: Store positions on the stack. For each popped position, check all four neighbors and push floor tiles you have not recorded.

hints.zh: 可以用 y * 宽度 + x 作为字典键。走到目标就立即返回 True，栈空了返回 False。
hints.en: Use y * width + x as a dictionary key. Return True as soon as you reach the goal, and False when the stack is empty.
